title: DEBUNKED: Why This Pro-Israel NYT Columnist Is WRONG About Gaza
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Ever since Israel began their horrific war on Gaza, many pro-Israel pundits
and genocide-denialists have suddenly decided that they know far more about
[war crimes,](https://news.un.org/en/story/2025/06/1164496) [ethnic
cleansing,](https://www.hrw.org/news/2026/02/04/israels-extermination-ethnic-
cleansing-escalate) and [genocide](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-
politics/2026-03-12/ty-article/.premium/netherlands-joins-south-africas-icj-
case-against-israel-over-gaza-genocide/0000019c-e312-d8a9-adbe-ef92fc730000)
than actual genocide scholars and human rights experts. How convenient!
